evidence_model.formula: literature_score = design_weight x study_factor x consistency x population_match, where design_weight and population_match come from the public literature HARM claim with the highest design_weight x population_match (all claims if none shows harm, so a strong null study never inflates the harm meter); study_factor = min(1, log2(1+n)/log2(1+5)) with n = distinct public literature sources; consistency = share of directional public literature claims in the majority direction (harm vs null), 0.5 if none. Meter: Strong >= 0.45, Some >= 0.2, else Early signs. Only layer=literature claims with badge != '?' count. System graph pathways and FAERS are reported in their own fields and are never multiplied in.
evidence_model.flag_change_rules: FLAG ('Check on this person') = association strength, causal or not: max over public literature harm claims of design_weight x population_match x severity (1.0 High, 0.75 Moderate) + 0.15 if FAERS specific-composite signal clears the negative-control band + 0.10 if any FDA label carries a heat warning + 0.10 if >= 6 of 8 jurisdictions mention it. High >= 0.6, Moderate >= 0.3. CHANGE ('Rethink the medicine') = literature_score x causal_factor + 0.10 if a cited lower-heat-risk alternative exists. causal_factor = 1.0 when the drug's own mechanism is shown in humans, 0.5 when within-person or adjusted studies show no added drug effect (confounding by indication), 0.75 otherwise; for storage/absorption drugs CHANGE concerns handling, not the molecule. High >= 0.45, Moderate >= 0.2; CHANGE is capped at Moderate when causal_factor <= 0.5. Strong within-person studies showing no added drug effect -> high FLAG, lower CHANGE (spec §9).

alternatives.name: A less anticholinergic bladder option (e.g. mirabegron, a beta-3 agonist)
alternatives.why: Oxybutynin scores 3 (highest) on the Anticholinergic Cognitive Burden scale; mirabegron is not on the scale. The Heidelberg heat table advises considering a switch to a less anticholinergic agent.
alternatives.what_is_lost: Different side-effect profile (e.g. blood pressure) and cost; efficacy differs by patient.

source.label: Heidelberger Hitze-Tabelle (2026): 'Therapiewechsel auf weniger anticholinerge Vertreter erwägen'

alternatives.caution: A spring-review consideration, never an automatic switch. Never stop abruptly; any change is the prescriber's decision.

combinations.label: Anticholinergic stacking (sum of ACB scores >= 3)
combinations.finding: Sweat blockers add up. Sum Anticholinergic Cognitive Burden (2012) scores across all medicines; >= 3 is the scale's clinically relevant threshold. Other drugs on the scale count too (e.g. paroxetine 3, furosemide 1); see data/kb/anticholinergic_burden.csv. Antipsychotic + anticholinergic in outdoor workers has fatal case reports.
combinations.plain: Several medicines that each reduce sweating add up, and together make it harder for your body to cool down.

timeline.action: Count total anticholinergic burden (ACB); at the spring review consider a less anticholinergic option, especially for older adults and Parkinson's disease.
timeline.basis: Martin-Latry 2007; Hospers 2024; Heidelberg table; ACB scale

timeline.action: Tell the patient and caregiver the warning signs (hot dry skin, confusion) and line up a cool place to spend the day.
Check in; skin that is hot and dry with confusion is an emergency: cool the person and call 911.
Review any heat-illness episode and the bladder treatment plan.

patient_messages.en: Heat warning for oxybutynin: in hot weather it can stop you from sweating, so your body heats up faster. Watch for hot, dry skin, feeling confused or very weak. Do not stop it on your own; stay somewhere cool and ask your doctor at your next visit whether another bladder medicine would suit you. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
patient_messages.es: Aviso de calor por la oxibutinina: con el calor puede impedir que usted sude, y su cuerpo se calienta más rápido. Fíjese si tiene la piel caliente y seca, confusión o mucha debilidad. No la deje por su cuenta; quédese en un lugar fresco y pregunte a su médico en su próxima cita si otra medicina para la vejiga le convendría. Hable con su médico o farmacéutico.
patient_messages.reading_level_note: Plain language; no dose advice; ends with 'talk to your doctor or pharmacist'.

gaps: Trial evidence for core temperature is atropine in healthy young men; oxybutynin itself has only case reports in heat.
No heat study of mirabegron or other non-anticholinergic bladder options (alternative is 'not studied in heat').
drugs.disclaimer: Prototype. Considerations for clinicians, not instructions. Not a replacement for clinical guidance. No dose advice. Patients: do not stop or change any medicine on your own; talk to your doctor or pharmacist.
